experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15062:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4446:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp334_smpl_geom/codex_review.md:14:复审确认：运行正确性 PASS（无 Critical/runtime/NaN）、单变量隔离（on vs off）成立、AMP/scheduler/eval/optimizer 全对、`_tokens` 返回 (cls, patches=(B,128,768))。翻转同步修复确认（未再 flag flip-High）、bn_body→LayerNorm 无污染、eval valid-gate 正确。**唯一保留 = 报告口径（3 文档必修项），已全部补入 design.md**：① alpha=0 是 backbone 正则诊断量非 baseline；② crop 错位记录在案（≤0.6 patch 零均值软噪声，test 对齐）；③ 重遮挡子集单列。smoke 实测端到端跑通（Epoch1 app+body 双损失、5 alpha eval、done）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5159:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_5.txt:27:机制草案：从 caption 中解析 `(part, attribute)` 图，自动生成最小反事实文本：上下装颜色交换、包/帽/鞋属性移动、长短袖互换等。训练时加入 image-text counterfactual margin：同一图必须更匹配原 caption，而不是 counterfactual caption；同时对 top-k hard images 做 binding-aware rerank。避免泛 part alignment，卖点是 minimal-pair robustness。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_5.txt:36:撞车核查：这条撞车风险高。[DiCo 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10053) 已做 concept/slot disentanglement，[InterPartAbility 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27122) 已做 phrase-region grounding，DualFocus 也碰 negative/mismatched attributes。必须把贡献写成**counterfactual binding benchmark + minimal-pair training objective**，不能写成又一个 part alignment。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5972:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7364:1. phase-var 作为"per-query 失败预测变量"**不干净**：控住 #false 后仍 +0.19（过了 Hubness 那道致命关），**但再控 LR-severity（single-LR→HR drift）后塌到 +0.03**。即 phase-var 解释"哪些 query 失败"的力量**大半与该图 LR 失真程度共线**，不是独立的"格点不确定性"诊断信号。→ **诊断/相关性 claim 弱**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7368:**AUTO VERDICT：GO**（h=16 过全部四关：volatility 强 ✓、lat_gain +4.23≥2 ✓、LAT-TTA +3.04>0 ✓、phase-var|#false +0.19>0 ✓）。区分 trivial 的两道生死对照（vs 普通 TTA、vs #false）都干净通过；唯一诚实降级是 phase-var 的**相关性**被 LR-severity 共线（写作时机制叙事走 interventional，不靠 (C) 相关）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7897:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5782:./reassess/r_3.md:3108:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3322:./validate/v_3.md:15165:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8290:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4503:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8291:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4542:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:2049:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:2850:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:837:./analyses/deep_4.txt:57:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4488:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:46:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the ideas are native rather than cross-subfield, but two components are concretely reusable in a different occluded pipeline: (1) Categorical learnable queries that explicitly separate \"visible-attribute\" tokens (A*) from \"occluder\" tokens (O*) via cross-attention to patches — i.e., learning an explicit occluder-description token forces the model to model the distractor rather than ignore it, which could be added to a non-CLIP backbone (e.g., Swin/PSG) as an auxiliary \"occluder branch\" whose features are pushed apart from identity features. (2) The entropy-based dynamic fusion: weight each candidate feature stream (global vs. part vs. pose-gated) by the entropy of its own ID-prediction distribution, so low-confidence (heavily occluded) streams are automatically down-weighted at the feature-fusion stage — a drop-in, training-only reliability gate that needs no extra labels and could replace fixed weights in a multi-branch occluded model.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4503:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:7976:./reassess/r_3.md:4190:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp170/design.md:49:- 使用与 PLBOA 相同的 VOC occluder patches（alpha blending）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:7995:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8000:./reassess/r_3.md:4488:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:46:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the ideas are native rather than cross-subfield, but two components are concretely reusable in a different occluded pipeline: (1) Categorical learnable queries that explicitly separate \"visible-attribute\" tokens (A*) from \"occluder\" tokens (O*) via cross-attention to patches — i.e., learning an explicit occluder-description token forces the model to model the distractor rather than ignore it, which could be added to a non-CLIP backbone (e.g., Swin/PSG) as an auxiliary \"occluder branch\" whose features are pushed apart from identity features. (2) The entropy-based dynamic fusion: weight each candidate feature stream (global vs. part vs. pose-gated) by the entropy of its own ID-prediction distribution, so low-confidence (heavily occluded) streams are automatically down-weighted at the feature-fusion stage — a drop-in, training-only reliability gate that needs no extra labels and could replace fixed weights in a multi-branch occluded model.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8003:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8011:./reassess/r_3.md:4501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8013:./reassess/r_3.md:4503:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8015:./reassess/r_3.md:4509:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp334_smpl_geom/claude_review.md:90:crop 框外（负坐标或 >W），此处正确忽略，不会把热图能量泄漏到边界 patch ✓。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8038:./reassess/r_3.md:4780:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:511:- **设计**: 3 occluder类(car/bicycle/person, VOC2012 分割patch)× 3 部位(head/torso/legs=上/中/下三分区, region-based 免pose)=9 cells; 训练见 6, hold out 3 对角(car-legs/bicycle-torso/person-head); ERM(mean CE) vs online group-DRO(7组=6cell+clean, present-group 重归一保 CE 尺度=单变量)。eval=Market 整体 query 施 cell 合成遮挡(按(cell,image)确定性seed, ERM/DRO 同遮挡), clean gallery, per-cell mAP。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8045:./reassess/r_3.md:4865:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp329_burstiness/design.md:12:遮挡 ReID 中, 少数**可见但过表达**的区域(大块近匀质躯干 patch、重复背景泄漏纹理)在很多 patch token 上重复出现; 检索对 token 求和/取 max → 这些 bursty token **抬高匹配分却不加身份信息**, 挤掉稀有可辨细节(包带/鞋)。按 self-similarity 反比降权(democratic 聚合)应提升遮挡检索, 且**与 visibility 加权正交**(可见 ≠ 不冗余)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8359:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8362:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1671:> 同 exp324 pipeline（pose 锚定 5-part + mutually-visible part-MaxSim + 重遮挡 vis.sum()≤8），**唯一变量=特征源**。hyy GPU1（5060 Ti），slim pose data（剥 heatmap，数值与 exp324 一致）。脚本 `scripts/exp327_dinov3.py`。**training-free，不计入主表增益。** DINOv3-vitb16 gated（hf-mirror 需 token）下不了，改用 ungated 的 `facebook/dinov2-with-registers-base`（registers 去 high-norm artifact token，更干净 dense 特征，patch14 grid 32×16，nreg=4）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8373:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1491:- 🔴 红队（方案 A）核心论点: SGMKC 实现成本极低（~15 行代码，无新参数），属于不同类别的改进（训练方法论 vs 架构/loss 添加），skeleton graph + masked prediction 组合是真正新颖的（FCFormer 用 transformer decoder，MAE 用 random patches，没有人在 skeleton graph 上做过 masked completion for ReID）。47 个失败实验都是架构添加或 loss 变体，SGMKC 是 self-supervised 训练策略——不同搜索空间。即使失败，负面结论也有论文价值。信心: 6/10

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8704:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8706:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8771:analyses/deep_4.txt:57:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8800:analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8839:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:59:3. **机制怎么长出来**：SGOS 用相邻卷积层的语义差异图找高响应位置，再把非人类 COCO mask 形状和语义 patch 融合成遮挡块，放到语义相关位置。LFSE 用注意力找关键区域和邻近区域，对邻近区域按重要性和差异性筛选，再作为附加语义融合到关键区域。Cross-center offset loss 则把最近的跨类 hard pair 推远。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14039:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MSAM 很自然地从这个重定义推出：既然噪声集中在高频，就用 Fourier 低通；既然单尺度会误删稀疏有效语义，就用 1×1、3×3、5×5 多尺度；既然频域滤波会过平滑，就接语义交互注意力补上下文。CPDM 则来自第二个观察：模型容易只盯少数局部有效点，所以连续擦掉不同横向 patch，迫使模型从剩余区域也能识别身份。机制和问题定义绑定较紧，但仍是“频域模块加训练正则”的组合型创新。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14093:**6. Texture-aware transformer with pose-patch mapping for occluded person re-identification.pdf**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14118:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MSAM 很自然地从这个重定义推出：既然噪声集中在高频，就用 Fourier 低通；既然单尺度会误删稀疏有效语义，就用 1×1、3×3、5×5 多尺度；既然频域滤波会过平滑，就接语义交互注意力补上下文。CPDM 则来自第二个观察：模型容易只盯少数局部有效点，所以连续擦掉不同横向 patch，迫使模型从剩余区域也能识别身份。机制和问题定义绑定较紧，但仍是“频域模块加训练正则”的组合型创新。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:86:**两数据集一致: 控住 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关塌到 ≈0（甚至略负）, 而 `#false-in-topk` 控住 M 后仍 +0.51/+0.18。** 即 M(q) 完全可被"top-k 里错的多少个"这个 trivial 计数取代, 反之不行。原 §3/§4 的 D3"partial+0.60"只控了较弱的 norm/margin/camera/#pos, **从未控 `#false-in-topk`**——这是 D3 漏掉的最致命代理。→ **"gallery 负向 in-degree / many-to-one 拓扑"作为 AP-err 解释变量, 相对 trivial 代理无增量价值。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:106:连续 rho 只 ~+0.25（被大量 M=0 query 稀释, 5 箱里 3 箱 M≈0）, 但**分箱趋势干净**: 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复增益最大的（OD 4.3×, Market 4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **P4 reframe 在分箱意义上成立**: "M(q) 标记了现成 re-rank 工具受益最大的 query"。这是验证后唯一仍站得住、可写的正向叙事（但注意 §P0c: M 此处可能也只是 `#false-in-topk` 的代理, reframe 同样可用 #false 复述, 严谨写作需在 P4 也加 `#false` 对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:109:~~M(q) 干净解释 AP 误差(rho+0.60, 控代理后仍在)~~ → **修订**: (1) rho+0.60/+0.65 含 circular self-loop, 去 circular（LOO/held-out）后降到 +0.33（OD）/+0.25（Market）; (2) **决定性**: 控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关 ≈0（两集一致 −0.06/−0.05）, 即"gallery 负向 in-degree / 拓扑"框架相对"top-k 里错几个"无增量解释力——原 D3 漏控了这个最致命代理; (3) P3 机制只半支持（去背景 −47%, 但去人 −87% 反更大, 非纯场景因子）; (4) **唯一仍正向**: P4 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复最多的（分箱 4.3×/4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **作为"诊断变量"的 headline 站不住**（被 trivial 代理吃掉）; 若要保留, 只能定位成"M(q)/负向 in-degree 标记 re-rank 高收益 query"的弱 reframe, 且必须诚实写明它相对 `#false-in-topk` 无增量。**当前形态不足以撑 analysis short 的核心 claim。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3037:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **evidence-sufficiency** 方向零训练 kill-switch LIVE+强: ①诊断真——weak positive-support(query 对自己跨相机正样本的最弱相似度 lowtail-pos / 正样本散度 dispersion)驱动失败, partial 控 1x-margin+#false 后仍 +0.44~0.52(两域), 决定性区别于被 trivial 吃掉的旧诊断(Hubness 控 #false 后塌到 0); ②oracle 证据 union——给失败 query 加第 2 张同 ID 图, Occluded-Duke 从 17.2→52.5(+35, 恢复 76.8%), 加随机异 ID 图反而砸毁(证明增益是身份证据非降噪), 且是 k-reciprocal 增益的 3.3x(现成 re-rank 盖不住)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:3038:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:17:① **method 是什么**? 候选: multi-query/tracklet 证据融合(evidence-aware, 用 lowtail-pos 决定何时/如何融) / retrieval reliability calibration(预测 fragile-query 给可靠性分, 不做恢复) / evidence-conditioned retrieval / 别的。关键约束: 利用'证据 union 有真 headroom'但—— (a)T3 是 oracle(需第 2 张同 ID 图), 真实部署'从哪来第 2 份证据'? multi-query/tracklet 设定可拿(注意: 这**不是** exp109 的 gallery-side completion identity-conditioned 墙, 是 query-side 多帧), 但 multi-query/set-based ReID 是已知设定, novelty 必须在'evidence-aware'机制不在'用多帧'本身; (b)不撞 occlusion/completion 死区; (c)T2 显示'静态失败预测'被 #false 吃掉, 别把 method 建在静态失败预测上, 要建在 tax-residual/fragility 或 evidence-gain 上。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2801:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5071:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_12.txt:12:做 `Camera-Pair Risk Equalization`。训练时把源域 camera-pair 当 episode domain，leave-one-camera-pair-out 做 meta-test；优化 worst camera-pair loss。另加一个轻量 pair-risk predictor，用 source camera-pair 的颜色、亮度、bbox ratio、view proxy、feature centroid distance 估计风险，训练时对高风险 pair 加权或做 pair-style counterfactual augmentation。全程不碰 target，不走 rerank。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7610:1. 触发观察：遮挡不是简单少了一块图像，而是会让可见人体部位和遮挡噪声混在一起，导致局部匹配错位。作者还观察到 Transformer 越深，patch 特征越相似，动态掩码很难生成有效的部位原型。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7651:2. 重定义动作：他们把 VI-ReID 从“模态差异问题”改写成“跨模态、跨粒度的对齐问题”。关键词是 global-patch-pixel、multi-granularity、saliency consistency、cross-granularity alignment、nearest-neighbor clustering。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7652:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本顺着重定义生长。既然单粒度不够，就抽 global、patch、pixel 三个层级；既然不同模态和粒度关注区域不一致，就用 saliency-enhanced Transformer 做同粒度跨模态融合和同模态跨粒度融合；既然同类跨模态距离仍远，就用 CNC 拉近最近邻同类样本。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7653:4. 证据闭环：MGFE 在 SYSU-MM01 两种模式下 Rank-1 分别约 +6.26 和 +4.47；MGFT 和 CNC 继续提升；三粒度组合明显优于单粒度或两粒度。热图也服务于视角，global 关注大区域，patch 关注轮廓和局部，pixel 捕捉姿态和手臂动作，组合后覆盖更完整语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6593:3. 机制怎么长出来：SPG 先产生局部语义 patch，AHSTG 用区分性和身份相关性打分，选择不同形状和尺度的异质 token；如果 token 间空间距离大，就认为中间可能缺失，插入 recovery token，并让近邻 token 权重大、远邻权重小。前半段逻辑很顺，DFR 的距离假设更像一个合理启发。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6598:1. 触发观察：作者抓的是 Transformer 遮挡 ReID 的通病，patch 被近似一视同仁处理，没有量化不同 patch 对身份的贡献，也缺少足够强的局部细节抽取能力。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6599:2. 重定义动作：它把遮挡问题从“遮挡区域要恢复”改写为“patch 要分层、前景背景要分离、局部交互要受限”。关键词是 `relative importance`、`patch-level saliency`、`feature hierarchical fusion`、`local-aware attention`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6600:3. 机制怎么长出来：FHFM 根据 class token 注意力和 patch 范数给 patch 排重要性，分四层融合；FSM 用 saliency map 分前景和背景；LFEM 加四个局部 token，并用 mask 限制只在同一人体区域内交互。逻辑能对上观察，但三模块有些“全都要”，绑定程度中等。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_5.md:8401:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用 ViT 得到全局特征和 patch 特征，用全局特征与 patch 特征的相似度排序，再用一阶差分估计可见人体区域比例。可见人体足够多就判为简单样本，只用全局特征提前退出；否则进入细阶段，用拓扑监督的 patch-to-part router 和 part experts 提取细粒度部件特征。这个机制和重定义绑定很紧，难度分流直接决定是否启用细粒度计算。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_5.md:8434:3. 机制怎么长出来：ABF 不直接切最后层特征，而是在 ViT 中后层复制 CLS 作为局部 token，并用 attention bias 限制每个局部 token 只关注对应 patch 组，同时保留全局路径。FEL 用共享可学习 token 和多模态解码器从文本中聚合细粒度语义。TES 用局部视觉表示监督 FEL，把 CLIP 空间里的余弦关系和欧氏距离关系转移给细粒度文本表示。MoD 和零初始化用于避免随机局部 token 一开始学噪声。这个机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_5.md:8475:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用 ViT 得到全局特征和 patch 特征，用全局特征与 patch 特征的相似度排序，再用一阶差分估计可见人体区域比例。可见人体足够多就判为简单样本，只用全局特征提前退出；否则进入细阶段，用拓扑监督的 patch-to-part router 和 part experts 提取细粒度部件特征。这个机制和重定义绑定很紧，难度分流直接决定是否启用细粒度计算。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6804:1. phase-var 作为"per-query 失败预测变量"**不干净**：控住 #false 后仍 +0.19（过了 Hubness 那道致命关），**但再控 LR-severity（single-LR→HR drift）后塌到 +0.03**。即 phase-var 解释"哪些 query 失败"的力量**大半与该图 LR 失真程度共线**，不是独立的"格点不确定性"诊断信号。→ **诊断/相关性 claim 弱**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6808:**AUTO VERDICT：GO**（h=16 过全部四关：volatility 强 ✓、lat_gain +4.23≥2 ✓、LAT-TTA +3.04>0 ✓、phase-var|#false +0.19>0 ✓）。区分 trivial 的两道生死对照（vs 普通 TTA、vs #false）都干净通过；唯一诚实降级是 phase-var 的**相关性**被 LR-severity 共线（写作时机制叙事走 interventional，不靠 (C) 相关）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:39:| 6 | **Rank-Regret** | 效率/Pareto | cheap-vs-full 排名不一致路由算力 | 撞 CFPER（RI partial 控 #false 后≈0）+ Swin 无 cheap exit（算力集中 stage2 92%，cascade 省 1-5% 无意义） |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:48:  - **★P0c 决定性**：控一个 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk`（=你自己 top-k 里错几个，**无需任何 hub/拓扑概念**）后，M(q) 偏相关塌到 **≈0（−0.06，两集一致）**；反向控 M 后 #false 仍 +0.51。**即"gallery 负向 in-degree / many-to-one 拓扑"相对"top-k 错的多少"无增量解释力。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:50:  - 残存 P4（高 M=k-reciprocal 修复最多 query，分箱 4.3×/4.5×）也可能只是 #false 代理。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:51:- **教训**：原 D3 漏控了 `#false-in-topk` 这个最致命代理，导致一个 trivial 计数被包装成"拓扑诊断"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:54:1. **★任何 per-query 解释变量，对照必须包含 `#false-in-topk`/top-k 错误计数这个 trivial 代理**——它能解释大量 AP 误差且不需要任何机制概念，漏控它会让"诊断"假阳性。这是本 session 最硬的一条。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:80:60:> codex 红队指出 M(q) 含 query q 自己对 H_k 的贡献 → 潜在 circular。三道复核脚本（`hub_verify_p0_p4.py` / `hub_verify_p0c_deep.py` / `hub_verify_p3_mask.py`, log `/tmp/hub_p0p4_{oduke,market}.log`、`/tmp/hub_p3_oduke.log`）逐条验证。**结论：原 rho+0.60/+0.65 被 circular self-loop 高估, 且 M(q) 控住 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后无独立信号——诊断的"hub/拓扑"框架不成立, 退化为"top-k 里错的多"。诚实记录。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:85:77:### P0c ★控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk`（= q 自己 top-k 里有几个异身份, 无需任何 hub/图概念）——决定性

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:92:86:**两数据集一致: 控住 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关塌到 ≈0（甚至略负）, 而 `#false-in-topk` 控住 M 后仍 +0.51/+0.18。** 即 M(q) 完全可被"top-k 里错的多少个"这个 trivial 计数取代, 反之不行。原 §3/§4 的 D3"partial+0.60"只控了较弱的 norm/margin/camera/#pos, **从未控 `#false-in-topk`**——这是 D3 漏掉的最致命代理。→ **"gallery 负向 in-degree / many-to-one 拓扑"作为 AP-err 解释变量, 相对 trivial 代理无增量价值。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:95:106:连续 rho 只 ~+0.25（被大量 M=0 query 稀释, 5 箱里 3 箱 M≈0）, 但**分箱趋势干净**: 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复增益最大的（OD 4.3×, Market 4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **P4 reframe 在分箱意义上成立**: "M(q) 标记了现成 re-rank 工具受益最大的 query"。这是验证后唯一仍站得住、可写的正向叙事（但注意 §P0c: M 此处可能也只是 `#false-in-topk` 的代理, reframe 同样可用 #false 复述, 严谨写作需在 P4 也加 `#false` 对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:96:109:~~M(q) 干净解释 AP 误差(rho+0.60, 控代理后仍在)~~ → **修订**: (1) rho+0.60/+0.65 含 circular self-loop, 去 circular（LOO/held-out）后降到 +0.33（OD）/+0.25（Market）; (2) **决定性**: 控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关 ≈0（两集一致 −0.06/−0.05）, 即"gallery 负向 in-degree / 拓扑"框架相对"top-k 里错几个"无增量解释力——原 D3 漏控了这个最致命代理; (3) P3 机制只半支持（去背景 −47%, 但去人 −87% 反更大, 非纯场景因子）; (4) **唯一仍正向**: P4 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复最多的（分箱 4.3×/4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **作为"诊断变量"的 headline 站不住**（被 trivial 代理吃掉）; 若要保留, 只能定位成"M(q)/负向 in-degree 标记 re-rank 高收益 query"的弱 reframe, 且必须诚实写明它相对 `#false-in-topk` 无增量。**当前形态不足以撑 analysis short 的核心 claim。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:596:| 6 | **Rank-Regret** | 效率/Pareto | cheap-vs-full 排名不一致路由算力 | 撞 CFPER（RI partial 控 #false 后≈0）+ Swin 无 cheap exit（算力集中 stage2 92%，cascade 省 1-5% 无意义） |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:605:  - **★P0c 决定性**：控一个 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk`（=你自己 top-k 里错几个，**无需任何 hub/拓扑概念**）后，M(q) 偏相关塌到 **≈0（−0.06，两集一致）**；反向控 M 后 #false 仍 +0.51。**即"gallery 负向 in-degree / many-to-one 拓扑"相对"top-k 错的多少"无增量解释力。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:607:  - 残存 P4（高 M=k-reciprocal 修复最多 query，分箱 4.3×/4.5×）也可能只是 #false 代理。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:608:- **教训**：原 D3 漏控了 `#false-in-topk` 这个最致命代理，导致一个 trivial 计数被包装成"拓扑诊断"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:611:1. **★任何 per-query 解释变量，对照必须包含 `#false-in-topk`/top-k 错误计数这个 trivial 代理**——它能解释大量 AP 误差且不需要任何机制概念，漏控它会让"诊断"假阳性。这是本 session 最硬的一条。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1122:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:95:106:连续 rho 只 ~+0.25（被大量 M=0 query 稀释, 5 箱里 3 箱 M≈0）, 但**分箱趋势干净**: 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复增益最大的（OD 4.3×, Market 4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **P4 reframe 在分箱意义上成立**: "M(q) 标记了现成 re-rank 工具受益最大的 query"。这是验证后唯一仍站得住、可写的正向叙事（但注意 §P0c: M 此处可能也只是 `#false-in-topk` 的代理, reframe 同样可用 #false 复述, 严谨写作需在 P4 也加 `#false` 对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1123:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:96:109:~~M(q) 干净解释 AP 误差(rho+0.60, 控代理后仍在)~~ → **修订**: (1) rho+0.60/+0.65 含 circular self-loop, 去 circular（LOO/held-out）后降到 +0.33（OD）/+0.25（Market）; (2) **决定性**: 控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关 ≈0（两集一致 −0.06/−0.05）, 即"gallery 负向 in-degree / 拓扑"框架相对"top-k 里错几个"无增量解释力——原 D3 漏控了这个最致命代理; (3) P3 机制只半支持（去背景 −47%, 但去人 −87% 反更大, 非纯场景因子）; (4) **唯一仍正向**: P4 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复最多的（分箱 4.3×/4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **作为"诊断变量"的 headline 站不住**（被 trivial 代理吃掉）; 若要保留, 只能定位成"M(q)/负向 in-degree 标记 re-rank 高收益 query"的弱 reframe, 且必须诚实写明它相对 `#false-in-topk` 无增量。**当前形态不足以撑 analysis short 的核心 claim。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1450:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12114:3. 机制怎么长出来：`A-SDM` 很自然，若真实正样本相似度低于 batch 中最高相似样本，就增大该正样本的拉近权重。`EFA` 也顺着“可检查”长出来，用词 token 和图像 patch 的稀疏相似矩阵显式聚合，再用 hard coding 和排序损失约束 joint embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1454:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12142:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果同一身份的文本 token 应该稳定对齐多个视角图像，就自然推出 `TCL`，约束同一身份多视角图像与文本的相似度方差；如果文本 token 已经学到稳定身份语义，就用 `SFM` 通过文本引导的空间注意力和通道重权重过滤图像 patch。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1612:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6933:机制也比较自然。为了不逐对比对，就仍然保留 ReID 的特征提取加相似度检索范式。为了用 LVLM 的语义理解能力，就用指令让 Qwen2-VL 针对行人图像生成一个 `<REID>` 语义 token，要求关注年龄、性别、衣着、生物特征。为了让这个 token 不只是孤立文本输出，设计 SGI，把语义 token 和视觉 tokens 拼起来经过 4 层 Transformer 交互，最后用强化后的语义 token 作为身份表示。为了处理相机变化，又加 camera semantic supplementation，最好的是把相机 embedding 加到视觉 patch embedding 上。训练用 ID loss 和 triplet loss，LLM 冻结但允许梯度穿过它更新视觉模型和 SGI。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3157:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3159:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3042:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1611:3. 机制怎么长出来：ABF 不直接切最后层特征，而是在 ViT 中后层复制 CLS 作为局部 token，并用 attention bias 限制每个局部 token 只关注对应 patch 组，同时保留全局路径。FEL 用共享可学习 token 和多模态解码器从文本中聚合细粒度语义。TES 用局部视觉表示监督 FEL，把 CLIP 空间里的余弦关系和欧氏距离关系转移给细粒度文本表示。MoD 和零初始化用于避免随机局部 token 一开始学噪声。这个机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3169:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3095:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1823:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果同一身份的文本 token 应该稳定对齐多个视角图像，就自然推出 `TCL`，约束同一身份多视角图像与文本的相似度方差；如果文本 token 已经学到稳定身份语义，就用 `SFM` 通过文本引导的空间注意力和通道重权重过滤图像 patch。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7696:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:12734:validate/v_3.md:2776:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3981:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:405:按用户睡前"不停+cheap kill-switch first"，自主把 TBPS 唯一幸存候选 PartNC 推到"数据一到就能判生死"：agent 读懂 RDE 接口(checkpoint 加载 / image 192-patch+text 77-token 特征 / CCD 的 min-max+2-GMM+低均值簇后验)，写 `scripts/partnc_killswitch.py`(本地+lab-3090-d，md5 一致)：(a) spaCy+lexicon 切 caption head/torso/legs + 部位级噪声注入(参数化, 有 regex fallback)；(b) RDE token 特征算 noun-phrase×patch per-part MaxSim cleanliness(复刻 eval_fliptest_maxsim einsum.max)；(c) AUROC(part-level) vs AUROC(实例级CCD)；(d) verdict。逻辑全验证通过(切分/注入/加载/形状/MaxSim/GMM/AUROC 方向性单测)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7885:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1887:./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7932:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:9175:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6933:机制也比较自然。为了不逐对比对，就仍然保留 ReID 的特征提取加相似度检索范式。为了用 LVLM 的语义理解能力，就用指令让 Qwen2-VL 针对行人图像生成一个 `<REID>` 语义 token，要求关注年龄、性别、衣着、生物特征。为了让这个 token 不只是孤立文本输出，设计 SGI，把语义 token 和视觉 tokens 拼起来经过 4 层 Transformer 交互，最后用强化后的语义 token 作为身份表示。为了处理相机变化，又加 camera semantic supplementation，最好的是把相机 embedding 加到视觉 patch embedding 上。训练用 ID loss 和 triplet loss，LLM 冻结但允许梯度穿过它更新视觉模型和 SGI。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11011:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2973:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1303:2. 重定义动作：大家以为主要矛盾是伪标签净化或 patch 设计；作者改成“先做语义感知的身份与摄像头解耦，再在身份相关特征上生成语义 patch”。关键词是 `semantic-aware disentanglement`、`identity-related features`、`camera-related features`、`diffusion over spatial transformer parameters`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11021:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11030:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3151:../litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:3140:cheap kill-switch：先在少量 AG-ReID/CARGO 样本上跑现有 SMPL/pose 管线，冻结 SOLIDER，只做 mesh surface pooling。若 SMPL 投影在航拍上失败率高，或同一表面区域的跨视角相似度不优于普通 patch/pose part，直接止损。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14407:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3158:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4718:reassess/r_2.md:2566:pivot/p_2.md:3657:./validate/v_3.md:15504:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:8060:./validate/v_2.md:12736:validate/v_3.md:2779:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3984:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:490:- **加 part-MaxSim kill-switch(防 false-KILL)**: pooled 判据可能误杀——cls 是训练检索特征, patch-pool 天生弱于它。加 token 级 part-MaxSim 版本(128 patch→6 水平 part-band, 全局 burst 权重降权 band 内 bursty patch, part-MaxSim 检索 burst vs uniform)。pretrained smoke 全跑通: pooled burst−uniform=-0.01, part-MaxSim burst−uniform=-0.03(均 KILL, 未训练应如此=harness 校准正确)。e120 自动触发用更新脚本, 一次出 pooled+part-MaxSim 双判据 + 训练模型诊断。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14578:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5462:reassess/r_3.md:4768:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15977:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4655:./reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:16072:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17524:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1920:reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17582:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17653:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17700:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17930:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17931:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17932:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4403:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17933:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

(2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. codex
**总 Verdict**

d17 现在不该直接替代 LM-ReID。  
我给它作为 **>6.5 B 类方法稿** 的先验成功率：**4/10**。  
做一个零训练 cheap kill-switch 很值得：**8/10**。  
但投稿策略上，当前更务实的是 **LM-ReID 6.5 收尾投**，d17 只作为 1-2 天内可杀的备胎，不应无限展开。信心 **7.5/10**。

d17 的上限在于：它如果成立，是“局部证据劫持 ranking”的机制问题，确实比普通 occlusion/part module 更像一个可讲的 failure mode。但它的最大风险也很硬：很可能退化成 `#false-in-topk`、ordinary mask-TTA、part/patch pruning、k-reciprocal/re-ranking 已覆盖的东西。

我查到的相邻边界也不宽松：DPEFormer 做动态 occlusion-free patch token selection，FPC/FRT 做 patch pruning、visible-region matching 和 recovery，advPattern 等做 ReID 局部/物理攻击，InterPartAbility 也已经用 counterfactual masking 做可解释检索评估。d17 必须切成“rank-level pair-specific counterfactual leverage + label-free intervention”，不能写成“发现局部区域重要”。

**(a) 能不能成 >6.5**

当前答案：**能，但赔率偏低。信心 4/10。**

成立条件非常具体：

1. `rank-leverage concentration` 在控制 `#false-in-topk`、top-1 margin、first-positive rank、top-k precision 后仍有独立解释力。
2. false positive pair 的 leverage concentration 明显高于 true positive pair，且在相同 rank / similarity 桶内成立。
3. label-free remedy 能提升实际 mAP/R1，并且超过 ordinary mask-TTA、random stripe masking、uniform part average、k-reciprocal 后 residual。
4. remedy 不是纯诊断，必须能部署：不能用 `y_g != y_q` 才知道该压谁。

如果只得到“false top-k 的局部遮挡后 rank 变化更大”，但控 `#false` 后消失，d17 直接死。  
如果诊断活、intervention 不涨，最多是 4.5-5.0 analysis，不如 LM。

**(b) Cheap Kill-Switch**

建议做三段，全部零训练，Market + Occluded-Duke 同跑。

**D17-KS1：pair-level counterfactual**
- 固定强 frozen ckpt。
- 对 query-gallery topK，K=10/20。
- 预生成 query/gallery 的局部遮挡 embedding：6-8 个 horizontal stripes + 4x2 grid patches。
- 对每个 pair 算：
  `L_r = max(0, sim(q,g) - sim(mask_r(q),g), sim(q,g) - sim(q,mask_r(g)))`
- concentration：
  `RLC_pair = max_r L_r / (sum_r L_r + eps)` 或 HHI/Gini。
- 检验 false pair vs true pair，必须在相同 similarity/rank/margin 桶内 false 更集中。
- GO 线：AUC false-vs-true `>=0.65` 两集至少一主一辅成立；`<=0.58` 直接死。

**D17-KS2：per-query 控制 trivial proxy**
- 定义 label-aware 诊断：
  `RLC_false(q)=concentration(sum_{false g in topK} w_rank * L_{qg,r})`
- 同时定义 label-free 部署版：
  `RLC_all(q)=concentration(sum_{g in topK} w_rank * L_{qg,r})`
- 必控：
  `#false-in-topk`、topK precision、top1 correct、first positive rank、top1 margin、#positive gallery、camera、feature norm。
- 报：
  `partial corr(AP_err, RLC | #false + controls)`  
  以及反向：
  `partial corr(AP_err, #false | RLC + controls)`
- GO 线：`RLC | #false+controls >= +0.18~0.20`，并且反向 #false 仍强但 RLC 不塌到 0。  
- KILL：`<= +0.10` 或只在 #false 高的 query 有效。

**D17-KS3：label-free intervention**
先只 rerank top-50，不全库重算。

三个候选 scoring：
- `RLC-cap`: `score' = score - λ * max_r L_r`
- `soft-min counterfactual`: `score' = logmeanexp_r(sim(mask_r(q), g) / τ)`，惩罚靠单一区域撑住的 pair
- `trimmed-mask score`: 去掉最有利/最不稳定 region 后取 median/mean

强 baseline 必须一起跑：
- full score
- ordinary mask-TTA mean/median
- random stripe cap
- uniform part/stripe average
- k-reciprocal 或已有 rerank 后 residual

GO 线：
- vs full：Market `+0.3~0.5 mAP`，OD `+0.8~1.0 mAP`
- vs ordinary mask-TTA：至少再 `+0.3~0.5`
- 高 RLC query subset 大涨，但低 RLC query 不明显掉
- 不能只提升 label-aware false subset

KILL 线：
- remedy ≈ ordinary mask-TTA
- remedy 被 k-reciprocal 完全盖住且无 residual
- OD 掉点，说明局部 evidence 对 weak-positive query 是救命信息，不能 cap

**(c) 和 LM-ReID 比**

我建议：**LM-ReID 继续收尾投，d17 只跑 kill-switch。**

LM 的优点是已经成立：
- sampling-lattice hidden variable 有 interventional 证据；
- 普通/强 TTA 对照已过；
- 多分辨率、bbox/kernel 分解、backbone 泛化都有；
- 缺点明确：test-time-only、detector 误差下 marginalization 衰减，天花板 6.5。

d17 当前只是一个漂亮假设。它可能比 LM 更“方法稿”，但只有在 intervention 过强 baseline 时才成立。否则它会重演 hubness/evidence 的坑：看起来像机制，最后被 trivial proxy 或现成 test-time 工具吃掉。

**最终排序**
1. **LM-ReID 收尾投**：6.5/10，务实，信心 7.5/10。
2. **d17 零训练 kill-switch**：值得做，信心 8/10。
3. **d17 全方法稿 pivot**：只有 KS1-3 全 GO 后再转；当前信心 4/10，条件通过后可升到 6.5/10。
4. **d17 diagnosis-only**：不建议，最多 4.5/10。

参考边界：DPEFormer（https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435）、FPC（https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.14742）、FRT（https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.01879）、advPattern（https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.09327）、InterPartAbility（https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27122）。
